mapper.sql: id, task_no, payload, status, expect_time, actual_time, retry_count, create_time
mapper.insert: insert into classic_delay_task (task_no, payload, status, expect_time, retry_count) values (#{taskNo}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{expectTime}, #{retryCount})
mapper.update: update classic_delay_task set status = 3, actual_time = #{actualTime} where payload = #{payload} and status in (1, 2) order by expect_time asc limit 1
